newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO generator to remain shut until Jan - official.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO generator to remain shut until Jan - official.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co's (TEPCO) thermal power generator at its Anegasaki plant, closed in June due to an explosion, will remain shut until at least January, a Trade Ministry official said on Tuesday.
Local officials started inspecting the accident site earlier this month and it will take the rest of the year to analyse the data, he said.
"We would like to find out the cause of the accident by January," the official said.
TEPCO will not be allowed to restart the reactor, located in Chiba, east of Tokyo, before the cause of the blast is identified and safety measures are put in place, he said.
The 600,000-kilowatt generator, which runs on liquefied natural gas and liquefied petroleum gas, was closed following the explosion on June 18.
